description: Log file lines -> training dataset rows [dt, x_1..x_n].

cases.name: log_to_dataset
cases.description: Log rows are 'timestamp,source,x_1,...,x_n' with ISO 8601 timestamps. Only 'interface' rows are used. Each dataset row is [dt, x_1, ..., x_n] where dt is the time since the previous interface row, so the first row is dropped.

cases.name: malformed_rows_skipped
cases.description: Rows with too few values or unparseable numbers or timestamps are skipped; dt is measured between the remaining rows.
